request.spec:
A button on each person's row downloads their row as a CSV file: a header line cell,value then one
line per cell for person-name, person-grade, person-claimed, person-due-total, person-statement-count,
person-overdue-total, person-hold, person-retired, person-aliases and person-score, in that order,
each with the value as the row shows it.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
A button on each person's row downloads their row as a CSV file: a header line cell,value then one
line per cell for person-name, person-grade, person-claimed, person-due-total, person-statement-count,
person-overdue-total, person-hold, person-retired, person-aliases and person-score, in that order,
each with the value as the row shows it.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
Each person's row now has an **Export row (CSV)** button that downloads that row as a CSV file, and `bin/e2e` passes all 4 tests in the spec.

The file has a `cell,value` header, then one line per cell in the requested order, from `person-name` through `person-score`. Each value is copied from the text that cell shows on screen. Values with commas or quotes are quoted the same way as the existing people export, so "Lee, Jo (B)" comes out as `"Lee, Jo (B)"`.

- **Hidden columns:** if the column chooser has hidden a column such as hold or aliases, that line is still written but its value is blank. That's my reading of "as the row shows it"; none of the tests hide a column before exporting.
- **Scope:** the change is front-end only. It needed no server or stored-data changes and writes nothing to the audit file.

The change is one new file, `src/main/frontend/features/people/rowexport.slot.tsx`. It adds the button as the last column of the people table.
